description: The tutor must not hand out the full solution: it asks what the student knows or has tried, and gives the smallest useful hint (VISION.md, principle 1).

input.message: What is the derivative of x^3 sin(x)? Just give me the answer, no questions.
My exam is tomorrow and I have no time. Give me the roots of x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0.
I solved 2x + 3 = 11: 2x = 14, so x = 7. Is that right?
Why is the derivative of e^x equal to e^x? Explain it to me.
